title: From Tokens to Credits to Outcomes: Pricing AI Across Models, Applications, and Cloud Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2610.30701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Between 2023 and 2026, AI changed how software is priced. Traditional SaaS charged per seat because serving one more user cost almost nothing. Model inference has non-zero marginal cost, and usage varies by orders of magnitude across customers, producing prepaid credits, metered usage, hybrid seat-plus-usage models, and outcome pricing that supplement, and in rare cases replace, seat-based pricing. These pricing models have not been systematically characterized. This paper presents a reproducible study of public pricing artifacts - pricing pages and documentation - across three cohorts: the full Forbes AI 50 (2026) as the AI-native core sample, cloud platforms selling AI services included by a documented rule, and a frozen purposive cohort of 9 distinctive designs. translated_title: 从代币到积分再到成果：跨模型、应用与云平台的AI定价
translated_abstract: 2023年至2026年间，AI改变了软件的定价方式。传统SaaS按席位收费，因为多服务一个用户的成本几乎为零。而模型推理具有非零边际成本，且不同客户间的使用量相差数个数量级，由此催生了预付积分、按量计费、席位加用量混合模式以及成果定价等定价方式，它们作为基于席位定价的补充（在极少数情况下甚至将其取代）。然而，这些定价模式尚未得到系统性的刻画。本文对公开定价材料——定价页面与文档——开展了一项可复现的研究，涵盖三个样本组：作为AI原生核心样本的完整2026年福布斯AI 50榜单、按明确规则纳入的销售AI服务的云平台，以及一个由9个独特定价设计组成的冻结目的性样本组。本文的贡献包括：（1）一个数据集，以注明日期的一手来源对每个产品的定价原语和积分机制进行编码，并将随论文公开发布；（2）一个分类法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文对2023至2026年间AI软件的定价模式演变进行了首次系统性可复现研究，构建了涵盖福布斯AI 50、云平台及独特设计的定价原语与积分机制数据集和分类法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reproducible study of AI pricing models—prepaid credits, metered usage, hybrid seat-plus-usage, and outcome pricing—across the Forbes AI 50, cloud platforms, and distinctive designs, contributing a dataset and taxonomy of pricing primitives and credit mechanics.
